1.w: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O YHWH, do not rebuke me in Your wrath and chastise me in Your fury.

2.w: For Your arrows descend into me, and Your hand comes down on me.

3.w: No soundness [is] in my flesh before the face of Your anger; no peace [is] in my bones before the face of my sin.

4.w: For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a heavy burden, they are heavy for me.

5.w: My wounds are foul and festering, before the face of my foolishness.

6.w: I am bent, I am bowed down even to excess; all the day I go about mourning.

7.w: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

8.w: I am numb and crushed, even to excess; I roar from the groaning of my heart.

9.w: O Lord, all my desire [is] before You, and my groaning is not hidden from You.

10.w: My heart pounds, my strength has forsaken me, and the light of my eyes—even they [are] not with me.

11.w: My beloved and my friends stand away from my plague; my neighbors stand far off.

12.w: And those seeking my soul lay snares, and those searching out my harm speak; they ponder destruction and treachery all the day.

13.w: And I [am] like a deaf one [who] does not hear and like a mute one [who] does not open his mouth.

14.w: And I am like a man who is not hearing, and in his mouth [are] no rebukes,

15.w: because for You, O YHWH, I have waited; You will answer, O Lord my God.

16.w: For I said, “Lest they rejoice over me; in the slipping of my foot they magnify themselves against me.”

17.w: For I am ready to fall, and my sorrow [is] before me continually.

18.w: For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious over my sin.

19.w: And my enemies without cause are many, and those hating me without cause have been multiplied.

20.w: And those repaying evil for good, they oppose me, because of my pursuing good.

21.w: Do not forsake me, O YHWH; O my God, do not be far from me!

22.w: Hurry to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
